name: Alphard 350S C-Package
summary: 2009 350S C-Package, 61k miles, £11,995. White pearl, 2WD (GGH20). Beige cloth interior, ottoman captain chairs row 2, bench row 3. Twin sunroof, wood-grain trim, push start. BIMTA/JERVIC certified. 12-month warranty. Due late April.
